name: Real-Time Traffic Incident Reports
description: This dataset contains traffic incident information from the Austin-Travis County traffic reports collected from the various Public Safety agencies through a data feed from the Combined Transportation, Emergency, and Communications Center (CTECC). For further context, see: - Active Incidents: Map and Context - Data Trends and Analysis The dataset is updated every 5 minutes with the latest snapshot of active traffic incidents.

approvals.message: The `strict_permissions` flag must be on to enable internal approvals.

columns.name: Traffic Report ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the traffic report

columns.name: Published Date
columns.description: The date the report was published

columns.name: Issue Reported
columns.description: The reported issue, based on the selection by reporting agency

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The reported incident location (point)

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: Latitude of the reported incident location

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: Longitude of the reported incident location

columns.name: Address
columns.description: The address at which the incident was reported.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Indicates if the reported incident is active or archived.

columns.name: Status Date
columns.description: The date/time at which the traffic incident was last updated.

columns.name: Agency
columns.description: The agency reporting the incident

columns.name: Boundaries: Austin MSA Census Tracts 2010
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Boundaries: Austin MSA Census Tracts 2010' (pgdr-vyqg) the point in column 'location' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.
